problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet to deliver five distinct categories of cargo, each requiring passage through five sequential checkpoint processing stages.  
The revenue generated per ton for each cargo category is as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 11.662 per ton  
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 16.84 per ton  
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 10.833 per ton  
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 17.103 per ton  
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 10.843 per ton  

The handling duration required per ton at each checkpoint is detailed below:  
* For Cargo Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.596 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.553 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.892 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.256 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.29 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.899 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.621 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.352 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.536 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.303 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.349 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.512 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.299 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.303 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.469 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.122 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.712 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.779 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.836 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.025 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.337 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.129 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.922 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.918 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.874 (ton-hours)  

The cumulative handling duration at each checkpoint is constrained by its available operational capacity:  
* Checkpoint 1’s total handling duration cannot exceed 200.957 hours  
* Checkpoint 2’s total handling duration cannot exceed 131.12 hours  
* Checkpoint 3’s total handling duration cannot exceed 260.055 hours  
* Checkpoint 4’s total handling duration cannot exceed 290.664 hours  
* Checkpoint 5’s total handling duration cannot exceed 186.637 hours  

Given the necessity to respect each checkpoint’s capacity limitation, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category so as to maximize the aggregate revenue.
